full_judgment:
7. Mr Mustafa Niaz Muhammad, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the Court of appeal below committed an error of law in passing the impugned judgment and decree in failing to appreciate the case of the respective parties in its true perspective resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice, as such the same is liable to be set aside. He next submits that the impugned judgment of the Appellate Court below is not based on proper appreciation of facts and materials on record and as such the impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal. 

 9. Mr Abdul Quyum, the learned Advocate appearing for the added-opposite-party No 21 submits that the learned District Judge committed an error of law in passing the impugned Judgment and decree without adverting the findings and reasons of the trial Court, resulting in an error of the decision occasioning failure, of justice. He further submits that the trial Court below referring the materials on record came to a finding that the plaint does not disclose any cause of action for the suit but the lower appellate Court as a last Court of fact without adverting any finding of the Joint district Judge abruptly reversed judgment by making a general observation which is, in fact, not a proper judgment of reversal and, as such, the impugned judgment and decree suffers from a patent illegality and material irregularity which is liable to be set-aside. 

 18. Now, it remains for me to consider that the contention as raised by the learned Advocate that the Court of appeal below without averting any of the findings of the Joint District Judge abruptly reversed judgment by making a general Observation which is not a proper judgment of reversal. It is true in passing the impugned judgment the Court of appeal below did not discuss the reasons elaborately but from the materials on record it appears that the materials on record justify the order. It is now well settled that mere omission to assign reasons in the impugned order is not fatal if in law the order is sustainable. So, it is a mere irregularity and not an illegality and the impugned judgment and decree cannot be knocked down on that count.
